meta.title: Laser hair removal — skin that stays smooth
meta.description: Gentle laser hair removal for every body zone. Unhurried hands, clear explanations, and skin that afterwards feels like nothing at all.

hero.subtitle: Gentle laser hair removal, matched to your skin

laserReveal.title: Hair by hair, visibly less
laserReveal.lead: The pulse of light finds the pigment inside the hair, heats it in milliseconds and releases the root. The skin around it stays cool — and the leg stays smooth.
laserReveal.photoAlt: A shin before the treatment and the same shin after: hair on the left, smooth skin on the right
laserReveal.photoUnavailable: The photograph cannot be shown right now — the story goes on.

skinLayers.title: Where the beam actually goes
skinLayers.lead: Through the epidermis and dermis down to the follicle: only there is there enough pigment for the energy to land. Everything above it is left alone.

layerNotes.epidermis: The top layer. It holds little pigment, so the light passes through it.
layerNotes.dermis: Vessels and nerve endings run here — the heat barely touches them.
layerNotes.subcutis: Below the root. The energy of the pulse no longer reaches this far.
layerNotes.follicle: The root of the hair: most of the pigment is here, and this is where the pulse stops.

skinLayers.caption: A schematic drawing: the layers are out of scale so that you can see where the light lands.

howItWorks.title: What happens in the treatment room
howItWorks.lead: We walk you through every step beforehand: what we do, what you will feel while we do it, and what to look after afterwards. Nothing happens unannounced.

steps.title: A conversation
steps.text: We look at your skin and at how the hair grows, and ask about your health and what you used before.

steps.title: Getting ready
steps.text: The area is cleaned and protective glasses go on — yours and the specialist’s.

steps.title: Pulse after pulse
steps.text: The applicator moves across the area patch by patch. Every pulse feels like a short warm flash.

steps.title: Afterwards
steps.text: The skin is calmed down, and you hear how to treat it over the next few days.

benefits.title: Laser instead of wax
benefits.lead: Light works at the root, wax only on the surface. Precise instead of rough, predictable instead of random — and without the in-between phase of waiting to grow back.

items.title: It works at the root
items.text: The light is absorbed by the pigment inside the hair and quiets the growth zone.
items.wax: Wax pulls the hair out and leaves the root where it was.

items.title: Fewer ingrown hairs
items.text: The hair does not break off under the skin: there is nothing left to grow crooked.
items.wax: A torn hair often curls back under the skin.

items.title: No growing it out
items.text: Between appointments the skin stays smooth — shaving is fine.
items.wax: Wax needs length, and you have to wait for it.

items.title: The result adds up
items.text: Hair grows in cycles, and every appointment takes the hairs that are active right now.
items.wax: With wax everything starts over each time.

prices.title: Zones and prices
prices.lead: Every zone on its own, several zones as a package. You know what a session costs before it starts.
prices.perSession: The price is for a single appointment.

stats.title: What can be counted
stats.lead: Years, sessions, faces. Numbers never tell you everything about a treatment — but they do tell you how often we have done it.
